title.narrative: Women Economic Empowerment (WEE)

description.narrative: The project aims at improving the economic security, stability, and prosperity of women entrepreneurs and women-led MSMEs in Lebanon across selected productive sectors to support their livelihood and wellbeing. The project will address women sub-optimal economic participation through tackling institutional and structural factors that impede their active economic participation, but also inherent gender hierarchies and inequalities.
